candidates.summary: the _before/ tree ships in every realm preview and is linked from nothing, against the README's "click through to the before page"
candidates.failure_scenario: A pull request that changes a realm: renderBase writes the merge-base render of each changed realm into _preview/_before/ (main.go:275, Prefix beforeDir) and that tree is copied into pr-/ by pr-preview-publish.yml and served. pairGrid wraps only the after image in an (comment.go:120-121); the before cell is a bare (117-119), Index emits no _before link, and nothing else generated does either. A reviewer who wants the before page — what misc/gnopreview/README.md:84-85 says _before/ exists for, 'so a reviewer can click through to the before page and not just its screenshot' — has to hand-type the URL, and the bytes count against the 40 MiB per-preview cap and the previews site's budget for a page nobody can reach.
candidates.verify_by: grep -rn '_before' misc/gnopreview/*.go returns three hits, all declarations (main.go:224 doc, crawl.go:54 doc, shots.go:27 const); grep -n 'Before' misc/gnopreview/comment.go returns 106 and 119, both the PNG path, never a page link; ShotPair (shots.go:34-44) has no field for the before page, while ScreenshotPairs computes beforeFile and discards it after the screenshot
